limitations: One firm; budget demand and linear supply are specified rules, not estimated preferences.
A nominal payroll target is cash-capped, not chosen by profit maximization.
Physical inventory is tracked exactly but has no monetary asset valuation on the ledger.
Integer price ticks and price bounds can leave excess demand; rationing is reported.
Market batches are atomic, but failed multi-market steps are not rolled back or resumed.
No banking, monetary-policy optimization, price calibration or financial hedge integration.
Monthly dates use the existing business-day clock, not an actual/365 day-count basis.

open_findings: No independent review of any module (MGR-07 not satisfied)
The blueprint's 374-item checklist remains NOT VERIFIED pending review; CHECKLIST_STATUS.md distinguishes test evidence from full acceptance
A basic lint/type/test CI workflow exists; deployment security, model lifecycle, data-governance and compliance controls remain unimplemented
Monthly orchestration uses synthetic single-asset GBM, exogenous prices and separate hedge accounts; conditional risk freezes holdings and rates
